verdict: The biggest movement is a sharp 87.27% drop in Google Business Profile activity over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or a listing issue rather than paid media, as Meta and Google Ads show zero spend and zero leads over the past 28 days. GBP still generated 159 total actions (54 calls, 105 web clicks) in the 28-day window, making its sudden decline the top priority to investigate.

performance.verdict: Paid media is fully dark; GBP collapse confirms organic also fading.

findings.text: All paid spend is $0 for the full 28-day window — Meta and Google Ads have been completely dark, producing 0 leads.
Extension with Marwan overdue since 2026-08-31; unsigned contract gates the next 3 months of activity and budgets.
SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; intake bottleneck (contact rate) remains unresolved without these.
GBP actions collapsed -87.27% week-over-week; last 4 days in series show 0 actions vs. a prior peak of 19 on 2026-08-19.
Search clicks and GA4 sessions remain active (34 sc_clicks, 62–82 sessions in last 3 days), showing organic intent with no paid capture.

suggestions.text: Escalate extension signing with Marwan immediately — $0 spend and 0 leads for 28 days is a contract-gated blocker.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have been at $0 spend for the full 28-day window, producing 0 leads, and the engagement extension with Marwan was due 2026-08-31. Sohib to contact Marwan directly this week to confirm signature and reactivation date. Success is a signed extension and confirmed budget reactivation date on file by 2026-09-10. If unsigned by then, escalate to Nacer.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing — 0 actions for 4 consecutive days vs. 19-action peak; check for suspension or listing suppression.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped -87.27% week-over-week and have been 0 for the last 4 consecutive days (2026-09-01 through 2026-09-04), against a recent peak of 19 actions on 2026-08-19. Check the Google Business Profile dashboard immediately for suspension notices, ownership disputes, or listing edits that triggered suppression. Success is confirmed listing status (active or reinstated) and actions returning above 5/day by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Watch sc_clicks and GA4 sessions; organic intent is live (34 clicks, 62–82 sessions) but uncaptured without paid media re-activation.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks held at 34 on 2026-09-03 and GA4 sessions ranged 62–82 over the last 3 days despite $0 paid spend for 28 days — organic intent is present but converting nowhere. No paid action is possible until the extension is signed (S1). Re-check sc_clicks and sessions on 2026-09-10 alongside paid reactivation status to confirm whether intent holds once ads resume.
